index.heroTitle: Your property cared for. Your mind at ease.
index.heroText: Year-round property care on the Costa Blanca: inspections, key holding, cleaning, maintenance and guest support.
index.introTitle: One trusted local contact to take care of it all.
index.introText: Designed especially for owners who live abroad or spend long periods away from their property. We coordinate what is needed and keep communication clear.
index.s1p: Scheduled visits, visual checks, ventilation and condition documentation.
index.s2p: Routine cleaning, guest turnovers and pre-arrival preparation.
index.s3p: Trades coordination, minor repairs and follow-through until completion.
index.ownersTitle: Even when you are away, your home is not unattended.
index.ownersText: We inspect the property, document issues and coordinate solutions. You receive clear updates without managing providers from another country.
index.howTitle: How we care for your property
index.h1p: We check the agreed areas and overall property condition.
index.h2p: We record issues with photographs and clear notes.
index.h3p: When action is needed, we arrange the right professional.
index.h4p: You receive a clear update and confirmation when work is complete.
index.areaText: The exact service area can be adapted for each business using this template.
